1f91b566.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"On The Windlord."
1f91b566.title: On The Windlord

43567f4a.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"The Rebellion in Eldre'Thalas, Part 1"
43567f4a.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 1

43567f4b.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"The Rebellion in Eldre'Thalas, Part 2"
43567f4b.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 2

43567f4d.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"The Rebellion in Eldre'Thalas, Part 4"
43567f4d.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 4

909666a3.text: The cult hit us by surprise. Raani never saw it coming and Arvensus took a sword to the gut. For my part, I took a lightning bolt to the chest and blacked out. They never bothered to finish me off... I guess they assumed my wounds would do me in. When it's all said and done, I suspect they might.
909666a3.title: Bloody Note

accca090.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"An excerpt from the Shal'nan's speech at the groundbreaking ceremony for the Shrine of the Four Winds, Zephras Isle."
accca090.title: The Shal'nan's Abdication

10181|6887b693.name: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner
10181|6887b693.text:
I've heard of you. Windshapers. Wayward children of ancient Eldre'Thalas.

I once would have called you kin--albeit distant kin. Now I have no more in common with elfkind than I have with any of the other living races. All I value from any creature that draws breath is how well they may further the goals of the Forsaken. Make yourself useful to my people, and you will be welcome in our lands.

Go. Explore the Undercity as you like and enjoy its comforts, such as they are. Just remember, nothing escapes my notice within my own domain.

10266|3852bbda.name: Ug'thok
10266|3852bbda.text: Snarl calls me simple because I am too slow. I just want to do the job right, and that takes time.

10278|46a7802e.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|46a7802e.text: Karn says we need to listen to the spirits of the forge and of the steel, that they will guide us. I hear nothing but a ringing in my ears. Here, take a hammer and let us try to hear the spirits together.

10278|b24d3eb1.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|b24d3eb1.text: I listen and I listen but I don't hear these spirits that Karn speaks of.

10540|5004ab66.name: Vol'jin
10540|5004ab66.text:
Ah yes, I heard of the Windshapers. It be good to be meetin' you now.

You know, my people been fighting elves for thousands of years. If you be half as fierce as your cousins from Darnassus or Quel'Thalas, the Darkspear would be glad to call you friend.

I be wishin' you well in your travels, $c. We Darkspear know all too well what it's like to have no home, so I hope you be finding what your people need to save yours.

10540|7c6995ef.name: Vol'jin
10540|7c6995ef.text: I am Vol'jin, of the Darkspear. Do you be friend, or enemy?

10666|43217733.name: Gordo
10666|43217733.text: Us is busy with important things!

10666|5f4181c7.name: Gordo
10666|5f4181c7.text: Oh yeah. Us gots it right here.

11017|788cf9fc.name: Roxxik
11017|788cf9fc.text: Nice try, but you'll need some more experience before training with me! Back to the trenches!

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11046|28b8dee2.name: Whuut
11046|28b8dee2.text: Why should I pace myself if this is working?

11046|6253ba70.name: Whuut
11046|6253ba70.text: All the bottles on this table are potions I brewed today. And they say a watched pot never boils. Ha!

11084|b9560714.name: Tarn
11084|b9560714.text: I am pleased with your progress so far. Surely the Earth Mother has inspired your hands.

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

1383|da72a588.name: Snarl
1383|da72a588.text: So you think you are good enough to learn from me? The great Snarl? You are no more than a lowly worm beneath my boot. However, taking on an underling might make me seem more appealing to Sumi and Tumi. Let's see what meager skills you possess.

14726|65d66388.name: Rashona Straglash
14726|65d66388.text:
In these trying times, a simple donation of cloth can go a long way to help those less fortunate than ourselves.  Cloth goes a long way to making garments and bandages - both important for the war effort!

If you are interested in donating cloth pieces to the orcs of Orgrimmar, I will gladly accept them and make sure you receive the proper recognition for doing so.

For the Horde!

14728|9cac81e8.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
14728|9cac81e8.text:
Hail brother... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.

We tauren have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of tauren everywhere in helping us out!

1495|54c6960c.name: Deathguard Linnea
1495|54c6960c.text: Greetings, $C. Be wary as you travel east toward The Bulwark. Recent surveillance reports indicate increased Scourge activity in that area, so exercise caution.

1496|54d7bdcd.name: Deathguard Dillinger
1496|54d7bdcd.text: Take it, then. It seems Zygand is too busy for the agonizing trip here to retrieve it himself.

1499|9cb5b422.name: Magistrate Sevren
1499|9cb5b422.text: Ah, you there!  I have tasks to give, and I need not waste time explaining their crucial nature.  Listen close.

1500|2af9e51a.name: Coleman Farthing
1500|2af9e51a.text:
I hope you're well, all things considered.

Sit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

1518|173903a2.name: Apothecary Johaan
1518|173903a2.text: The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

1950|aa9cd6e2.name: Rane Yorick
1950|aa9cd6e2.text: My brother and I are on a vital mission, but we are holed up in this farmhouse.  The Deathstalkers need your help.

1952|7327dd7a.name: High Executor Hadrec
1952|7327dd7a.text: Hello, $C.  If you're here, then you must know that Silverpine is saturated with our enemies.  To survive, the Forsaken must drive them back!

2127|7c6cb2cd.name: Rupert Boch
2127|7c6cb2cd.text: I have no time to waste on the likes of you $c.

2131|ed01dd60.name: Austil de Mon
2131|ed01dd60.text: The $c's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2310|81663044.name: Jamie Nore
2310|81663044.text: I'm working on delicate matters of Horde intelligence. It would be best for us both if you did not disturb me.

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

246152|8754b3a4.name: Shari Stilwell
246152|8754b3a4.text: The light is a beacon that shines for all. What can I do for you, $c?

249363|595011e8.name: Yala Windwatcher
249363|595011e8.text:
The Wind Spirits have left us. 

Now, only mindless echoes remain. Be wary, however. These winds are neither kind, nor gentle.

250929|4b2429f8.name: Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct
250929|4b2429f8.text: <As you approach the enormous cyclone construct, you hear a faint buzzing emanating from beneath its massive armor plates. If you listen carefully, you think you might be able to hear a few words being formed but they are too distorted to make out.>

251001|379c835f.name: Deathguard Kristof
251001|379c835f.text:
Please do see that he reads it at once. I fear our Scourge problem has only just begun.

Come see me again in due time. I believe I have nearly uncovered something I could use a willing blade to help with.

251361|d8b5b5c2.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
251361|d8b5b5c2.text: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

251374|4d87d665.name: Windshaper Boro
251374|4d87d665.text:
The spirits of the wind may have left us, but the power of the elements is not entirely out of reach for those with the patience to seek them out.

If you are initiated in the ways of the shaman, I can help you grasp them.

251389|87ef59fc.name: Akeri Duskblade
251389|87ef59fc.text:
Slay your enemies and swoon your paramours with this one weird trick.

If you follow the path of the rogue, I can teach you... for a cost, of course.

251487|e92a645e.name: Ventaari Brightwish
251487|e92a645e.text: What may I do for you, fellow windshaper?

251523|14e578ce.name: Constable Aonda
251523|14e578ce.text: <Constable Aonda wears an intense look on her face, clearly deep in thought.>

251523|191d4b60.name: Constable Aonda
251523|191d4b60.text:
More than I'd like, I'm afraid. We've been harassed by a group of bandits camping out in a cave to the north, and the Al'Aketh cult recently took over Falaath Village to the south of us. I trust every peacekeeper and citizen here, but we are far too few to keep the village secure. 

If the cult decides to continue their expansion here, there's little we can do to stop them.

251662|18bda9db.name: Living Lightning
251662|18bda9db.text: <The roiling cloud of living lightning before you seems to crackle menacingly as you approach. It might be best to leave. Quickly.>

251684|5d8faa22.name: Strange Hermit
251684|5d8faa22.text: H-Hello. You'll have to excuse me, I'm used to your kind running from me.

251902|f56638d6.name: Illaya Amberwind
251902|f56638d6.text:
Greetings, child. I am Illaya Amberwind and I am the Elder Windshaper here on Zephras Isle. It's always nice to meet young new faces that make their way down from the grove.

Don't let this old shaman hold you up, no doubt you've got many adventures to see to. Do feel free to stop by later if you'd like.

251904|202faeeb.name: Sania Silverstream
251904|202faeeb.text: Greetings, $c. Do you come seeking the blessings of the Windlord?

251905|3541aa81.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|3541aa81.text: If you need training as a cook, I have a few tips and tricks I could pass on! Ho ho! Throw on an apron and let's get started!

251906|6574e2ad.name: Teeri Wellwind
251906|6574e2ad.text: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

251913|70e7404c.name: Aedi Thriceforged
251913|70e7404c.text: I can teach you to swing a blacksmith's hammer, if you are willing to learn.

251964|caa7ddf7.name: Blademaster Ren
251964|caa7ddf7.text: The $c who flinches is the $c who dies. If you would look death in the face as a $c, I will teach you how not to flinch.

251968|88447c8b.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|88447c8b.text: Greetings, I am Ayessa Dawnsinger, the current Grand Skyseer of the Windshapers. What may I do for you?

251968|97b43995.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|97b43995.text:
If the High Order gave any mind at all to actually solving the problems we face and spent less time obsessing over the old magic, we'd be in a far better position as a people. It was highborne magic that brought about the ruin of the kaldorei to begin with. Those self-absorbed fools seek to repeat those mistakes!

The fact that they attempted to make peace with the cult is bad enough, but spilling Windshaper blood is what is truly unforgivable. Were it not for the imminent threat of the cult, I'd gather up our forces and go put an end to Elaadrin and the High Order once and for all.

251968|ca320a53.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|ca320a53.text: Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The Windshapers will provide aid. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

251991|8173c391.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
251991|8173c391.text:
The clothcraft of the Shen'dorei is a harmonious imitation of the flowing, carefree currents of the winds. While the spirits have left us, and I know not when I may see them dance once more... I find great comfort in my art, if only as a distraction.

I can teach you to work the cloth as well, if you'd like to learn?

251993|453a25ae.name: Indari Sunseam
251993|453a25ae.text: I can teach you to craft fine leather armor, if you have the aptitude.

252068|63df4aea.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|63df4aea.text: Soon all Shen'dorei will see the truth... and those that refuse will be swept away in the coming storm!

252068|8cd3381f.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|8cd3381f.text:
Why are you bothering me, recruit? If you want to talk to other doe-eyed fools, try the inn on the north side of town. The recruits that congregate there tend to have brains as smooth as their freshly shaved heads.

Oh, and shave that head of yours. The only thing the windlord abhors more than chatty recruits is chatty recruits with a full head of hair.

Now, be gone from my sight.

252155|82bfc17b.name: Peacekeeper Vaaniel
252155|82bfc17b.text: <The corpse lying before you is covered in scorches and burn marks. He seems to be clutching something in his hand.>

252359|80b579b6.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
252359|80b579b6.text: Our kind are rare these days, but there are those who still dream in emerald amongst the Shen'dorei.

252377|caa7ddf7.name: Seena Skybreaker
252377|caa7ddf7.text: The $c who flinches is the $c who dies. If you would look death in the face as a $c, I will teach you how not to flinch.

252383|28d94b03.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|28d94b03.text:
I suppose that is true. I and the rest of my elites used to belong to an order known as the Empyrean Blades. We were the personal guard of our former leader, the Shal'nan. 

In the current, uncertain times we do what we can to help lead the peacekeepers' citizen militia, since we are the closest thing to professional soldiers left on Zephras.

252383|5676c909.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|5676c909.text:
<Valennia looks away briefly before looking hesitantly back in your direction.>

The Shal'nan was the very best of us. It was he who stood up for our people against madness and oppression in Eldre'Thalas nearly ten thousand years ago. It was the Shal'nan who led us across the uncharted sea to escape the murderous vengeance of our ancient enemies.

It was the Shal'nan who brokered the pact of friendship with the wind spirits that allowed us to ascend to Skywall... and survive.

He was ever the servant leader to his people, even after he abdicated his position of power and retired.

252383|8d2a94b9.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|8d2a94b9.text:
If I knew that then I suspect that life here on Zephras would be much, much easier. So many of our struggles and conflicts revolve around that very mystery.

I appreciate your curiosity on this matter but I'm afraid that is all I have to say about this for today.

252383|e7690d8a.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|e7690d8a.text:
The Peacekeepers can't hope to muster the numbers needed for an outright assault on the shrine. Without the Windshapers and the High Order bolstering our numbers, we stand no chance. They both pledged their aid when we need it. Now is the time.

Unfortunately, some recent events have led to outright bloodshed between the two factions, and tensions are high.

How do you feel about a bit of diplomacy?

252383|f5d2c665.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|f5d2c665.text:
I might be the only living shen'dorei left amongst our people who had more than a handful of words with him.

I served him as the captain of his Empyrean Blades for nearly nine centuries, right up until... he left us.

Even still, I can't rightly claim that I "knew" him. He was ever a reserved and solitary man. He spent most of his time alone or in communion with the spirits in the spires high above the Shrine of the Four Winds... the place that the cult now calls the 'Shrine of Akir'.

252448|14de7cf6.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|14de7cf6.text: It's always great to see you, $N.

252448|aadf0ebc.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|aadf0ebc.text: <The man lying before you shifts uncomfortably. He's recovering from some very nasty wounds.>

252475|3e3dd1cf.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|3e3dd1cf.text:
<Elaadrin eyes you with barely-contained hatred.> 

You would dare step foot into our sanctum after spilling High Order blood? You are very brave, or very stupid. The High Order does not forgive, nor do we forget.

Someday, you will pay for your crimes in blood.

252475|b7dd6ea5.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|b7dd6ea5.text:
Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The High Order will assist the Peacekeepers. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

<Elaadrin lowers his voice dangerously.>

Do not mistake our willing cooperation for any sort of clemency. You owe the High Order blood, and we always collect on our debts.

252476|fcd03afb.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
252476|fcd03afb.text: It is vital that we learn more about what the cult is planning, and with the turncoat dead, the information may have died with him...

252800|d3392a1d.name: Aamelia Windfield
252800|d3392a1d.text: The Windfield Orchard has seen better days...

253372|4b6a69db.name: Dead Cultist
253372|4b6a69db.text: <This cultist is dead. Upon close inspection, you notice that he seems to be clutching something to his chest, almost as if he was protecting it.>

253576|febbe4e4.name: Hyusaa Quickbreeze
253576|febbe4e4.text:
Most of the cultists at the Sanctum of Storms seem to have come out to respond to our attack. I never would have expected this to go so well. This was almost too easy...

I think that the Windshapers and High Order have made their push. Valennia should be with them. You should head inside and find her. We'll stay here and keep watch while Valennia and the others finish what they came here to do.

253590|2061ff16.name: Valennia Stormfist
253590|2061ff16.text: <Valennia is severely wounded and is barely holding on to consciousness.>

253849|6ace422f.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
253849|6ace422f.text:
Lorthuna is performing some sort of ritual up there. She may be trying to bring down the wards!

The help we sent for has not yet arrived, but we'll just have to manage with what we have. When you are ready, let me know and we'll go confront her.

254087|87ef59fc.name: Miriaan Mistblade
254087|87ef59fc.text:
Slay your enemies and swoon your paramours with this one weird trick.

If you follow the path of the rogue, I can teach you... for a cost, of course.

254088|caa7ddf7.name: Corsan Earthrazer
254088|caa7ddf7.text: The $c who flinches is the $c who dies. If you would look death in the face as a $c, I will teach you how not to flinch.

254089|9cc50b7d.name: Coriella Calmbreeze
254089|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

254128|8cbd94ac.name: Wardrobe
254128|8cbd94ac.text: <The two cultists nearby are talking. You might be able to learn something if you hide behind this wardrobe and eavesdrop.>

254151|197a65c0.name: Vayn Moongaze
254151|197a65c0.text: The Nightclaw do not take kindly to reckless intruders. Tread carefully while in Shadowgale, $c.

254151|20a1483e.name: Vayn Moongaze
254151|20a1483e.text:
You've earned a degree of trust amongst the Nightclaw, $c. We don't have much to offer you as a reward, but we have managed to scavenge a number of crafting plans from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

The magesmiths of Ban'aethal were widely regarded to be the best artisans in all of the $R Isles. The Nightclaw are naturalists, not crafters, so these records are of little use to us.

Continue to prove yourself to be a valuable ally, and I would make these secrets available to you.

255940|9cc50b7d.name: Donaal Downbreeze
255940|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

256076|f046599c.name: Damaged Construct
256076|f046599c.text: <A faint whirring sound can be heard coming from underneath the construct's metal armor plates. The wind powering this machine is present but is listless and only faintly churning. You don't need to know much about air constructs to know that this unit is clearly not in good repair.>

256083|35f76b60.name: Riaani Nightwind
256083|35f76b60.text: Have you found what we need yet?

256083|6571d699.name: Riaani Nightwind
256083|6571d699.text: <Riaani seems to be intently focused on his work on the wind construct.>

256247|c69f0372.name: Belathaan Brightwish
256247|c69f0372.text: What are you doing here? Quickly, leave this place now. You are going to ruin everything!

256635|824cc722.name: Peacekeeper
256635|824cc722.text: Adventurer! The wind bridge leading to the other spire is unstable. You may need to wait here with me until it returns.

256930|341966bb.name: Captured Bandit
256930|341966bb.text:
Most of my outfit did. Displaced from the ground falling out from under our feet. Some came from other islands entirely. I came from the city of Shen'dramar, on the big island. Well, what used to be the big island, I suppose.

My family and I managed to get on one of the last skycutters out of there before the entire island broke apart. We thought that Zephras would save us. Well, it didn't. They are all long dead and now I'm here, awaiting execution.

256930|70ce7a83.name: Captured Bandit
256930|70ce7a83.text: Desperation? Hunger? I'm not exactly here doing this because I like robbing and murdering. I lost my home, had nowhere to go, and I don't much care to shave my head and worship some imaginary wind god, so I became a bandit. The rest is obvious.

256930|b893349b.name: Captured Bandit
256930|b893349b.text: Largely, yes. The thing we all have in common is that we have nowhere else to go and that we prefer thieving over enslaving ourselves to some insane cult.

256930|d07034d1.name: Captured Bandit
256930|d07034d1.text: Killed a peacekeeper and stole some windstones.

256930|dc9d79f6.name: Captured Bandit
256930|dc9d79f6.text: Why bother denying it, the constable already passed her judgement. No point lying.

257006|d682c422.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|d682c422.text: E borne hir ash nuff garde re ruff vassild lon thorniss, far E regen E majis barad ras aetwinter lo ruftos ergin.

257022|5c2244b7.name: Messana Crestwind
257022|5c2244b7.text:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years, however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things.

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner, then I'm your shen'dorei.

257024|ec1a6e0b.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257024|fb513610.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

257036|a6bb08a8.name: Baelann Favorbreeze
257036|a6bb08a8.text: Welcome to the Bank of Valanaar. We can secure your belongings and valuables here should you so desire. Do you wish to access your deposit box?

257065|819f44a1.name: Missionary Jasaan
257065|819f44a1.text: Do you seek the blessings of the Windlord?

257554|41088e5c.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
257554|41088e5c.text: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>

257944|37940c1f.name: Elegael Thornpaw
257944|37940c1f.text: I cannot believe we were taken by surprise by the Al'Aketh. They have never been hostile to us before, but with their ambush they injured many of my kin. I swear I will get revenge for the fallen and wounded druids of my den. Mark my words, they will pay.

258130|5a52f936.name: Jorel Windsinger
258130|5a52f936.text:
<Before you lies the corpse of Jorel Windsinger.

Deep lacerations are cut into his legs, and lightning burns scorch his fur.

It is clear he put up a fight before succumbing to his wounds.>

259012|517aef13.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
259012|517aef13.text: All of the $r islands became destabilized and began to move apart a few years ago. If that wasn't bad enough, now large pieces of Zephras are beginning to fall away. It's hard to imagine your home falling into the sky, but that is my reality now.

259013|6750d3f2.name: Resaan Nimbuswalker
259013|6750d3f2.text:
<Before you lies a $r; his body is mangled and bruised but still recognizable. It is clear he met a gruesome end while attempting to flee.

It appears that all of his belongings are still on his body, and a half-filled crate nearby lies spilled on the ground.>

259118|b3bb7fbb.name: Muln Earthfury
259118|b3bb7fbb.text: I am Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring. What brings you before me today?

260093|58279558.name: Garen Largo
260093|58279558.text: Do you require training in the ways of the light?

262558|996eca9b.name: Palah Thunderhoof
262558|996eca9b.text: May the spirits be with you.

263113|81449513.name: Myriaal Mistwake
263113|81449513.text: It can get boring up here, you know. I can only annoy that stuffy wretch Halaan so much before even that gets old.

264078|adb68b1b.name: Sutara Plainstalker
264078|adb68b1b.text:
It is my honor to handle supply and provisioning for the Earthen Ring. 

My stock is limited at present, but check back with me often and I may have new equipment and supplies available for purchase.

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

267009|6f316d7a.name: Hadric Harlson
267009|6f316d7a.text: Be careful, $c. There are cultists nearby.

267327|d8b814ea.name: Kagil
267327|d8b814ea.text: Agol ne wirsh ver ne vandar novaedi veld algos nevren? Va se ras uden vrum bor garde?

267328|3f01eec2.name: Norzsh
267328|3f01eec2.text: You think you got what it takes to mine ore?

271465|92b9fbbb.name: Falfaan Halfwind
271465|92b9fbbb.text:
Greetings, $c. Are you in need of arms?

I was trained by Antarion of Ban'aethal, using secrets handed down from the ancient master magesmiths of Kalimdor.

You'll find no finer weapons on Zephras Isle than mine.

276171|1e85fa3a.name: Oura Stormspinner
276171|1e85fa3a.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

2857|6139c96a.name: Thund
2857|6139c96a.text: Who says Orcs aren't smart? It takes a lot of brains to be an engineer!

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

2998|0b7fce91.name: Karn Stonehoof
2998|0b7fce91.text: You have the look of a woman who seeks knowledge. Perhaps you seek the teachings of the forge, and the hammer. Perhaps I can guide you down that path. But only once you have accepted the spirits, and listened to their calling.

3007|b65785f5.name: Una
3007|b65785f5.text: It's been so long since I was a novice myself that I don't think I'd be the best teacher for you. Try talking to Tarn or Mak, right over there. One of them should be able to answer your questions.

3008|d055944a.name: Mak
3008|d055944a.text: Your talent is beyond my own, friend. Speak with Tarn here; his knowledge of leather is much greater than mine. I'm sure he would welcome another student.

3011|463ccfcd.name: Teg Dawnstrider
3011|463ccfcd.text: Enchanting has run in our family for generations. I learned at an early age, just as my son is doing now.

3026|0c543544.name: Aska Mistrunner
3026|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3043|4711dbab.name: Ker Ragetotem
3043|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3063|4711dbab.name: Krang Stonehoof
3063|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3084|73a86360.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|73a86360.text: Brek Stonehoof can be found at Stonehoof Geology on the lower rise and can teach you the proper way to harvest precious ores and gems.

3143|004c594f.name: Gornek
3143|004c594f.text: The Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a $c worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.

3153|640f312b.name: Frang
3153|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

3188|366172e1.name: Master Gadrin
3188|366172e1.text: There is something you wish to discuss, $c... come, sit by me.

3194|57542108.name: Vel'rin Fang
3194|57542108.text: I make sure Sen'jin is supplied with materials from the local beasts. It is an honorable role.

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3230|3b64a31f.name: Nazgrel
3230|3b64a31f.text:
<Nazgrel grunts as he sizes you up.>

High elves, here in Orgrimmar. I'd never bet on such a thing happening in my lifetime, but at this point nothing is surprising to me.

Yes, the Warchief instructed me to draft up instructions for you. Take this letter and follow the instructions within. Conduct yourself with honor and show due deference when you meet with our leaders, elf.

Once you've finished your journey, return to the Warchief.

3230|8d5031bd.name: Nazgrel
3230|8d5031bd.text: Mind yourself in the presence of the Warchief, $c. The Kor'kron will suffer no insolence or insult here.

3304|645294fc.name: Master Vornal
3304|645294fc.text: The sands of Durotar are tough and dry compared to the tropical and lush lands we're from, but we Darkspear persevere. Where chief Vol'jin leads, we will follow.

3318|6b36598f.name: Koma
3318|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3318|ae78a458.name: Koma
3318|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3347|9cc6e14a.name: Yelmak
3347|9cc6e14a.text: I'm busy, $N. Tell Whuut to handle whatever it is. That young pup has been stewing all day long. He spends much more time like that, and he's going to hurt something.

3365|0b0697d2.name: Karolek
3365|0b0697d2.text: Am I busy? What's that supposed to mean? Do you think I just stand here all day, twiddling my thumbs? If you're here to buy something, talk to Handor.

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3549|2cec462d.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|2cec462d.text: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

3688|4ef1d72e.name: Reban Freerunner
3688|4ef1d72e.text: Ah friend, I only help hunters and their pets.

4595|ed01dd60.name: Baltus Fowler
4595|ed01dd60.text: The $c's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5759|a28d29e1.name: Nurse Neela
5759|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

5811|6fac1a00.name: Kamari
5811|6fac1a00.text: You like the rug? I killed and skinned the beast myself. May all the centaur fall as easily.

5884|e98c6c9e.name: Mai'ah
5884|e98c6c9e.text: Greetings, $c.  I pity your kind, for the secrets of true magic are beyond you...

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

7683|a4ef73af.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|a4ef73af.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

7953|a3eec9a8.name: Xar'Ti
7953|a3eec9a8.text: You need to be exalted with the trolls of the Darkspear tribe before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.

8659|b2489254.name: Jes'rimon
8659|b2489254.text:
I give you warm greetin's, $c, as does the Shattered Hand.

Do not look so surprised, $N. There be shadows even on the highest perches of Orgrimmar--somethin' must hide there. The Shattered Hand take that role willingly. Thrall, even in his good heart, acknowledge that the Hand be necessary to ensure orc and troll safety.

But you not here to talk 'bout my business, you here for somethin' else.

1061-accept.name: Zor Lonetree
1061-accept.text:
The spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains are angered, for goblins and their servants are plundering and burning the land.  So the land has cried out, and those who listen for such things... have heard.

Seereth Stonebreak, a promising shaman of the Horde, was sent to Stonetalon.  She reports massive deforestation at the hands of the goblins, and requests aid.

Meet Seereth in Stonetalon.  To reach her, follow the road west of the Barrens' Crossroads.  She is camped near the Greatwood Vale.
1061-accept.title: The Spirits of Stonetalon

1359-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1359-accept.text:
The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens.  There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!

It's quite incredible, and we must study it further.  I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired.  Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge.  You will find her in our headquarters in the Undercity.
1359-accept.title: Zinge's Delivery

1487-progress.name: Ebru
1487-progress.text:
$N, we, the Disciples of Naralex, need your help. Our numbers are dwindling with our master trapped in his twisted nightmare. We have not the forces necessary to deal with the corrupt creatures which now haunt these caverns.

I beg of you, enter the caves and wage war on the deviate creatures!
1487-progress.title: Deviate Eradication

1498-accept.name: Uzzek
1498-accept.text:
As a $c, one of our most crucial tasks is... protection.  We are the shield of the Horde, and we keep our weaker brethren safe.  If you are to join in our ranks, then you must prove your mettle to me.

Go to Thunder Ridge in Durotar, where live the lightning hides and thunder lizards.  Hunt the beasts!  Show me you are tougher than they!  Brave their assaults and bring me a stack of their singed scales as proof.

Do this, and then I will teach you.
1498-accept.title: Path of Defense

1498-complete.name: Uzzek
1498-complete.text:
Ah.  I see you have defeated the thunder lizards, which proves you are tough.  Now I will show you how tough skin and shrewd movements can combine to form an impenetrable wall of defense.

Learn your lesson well, $N.  And be ready for future instruction.
1498-complete.title: Path of Defense

1498-progress.name: Uzzek
1498-progress.text: Do you have the scales, $N?  Unless you can withstand the attacks of the thunder lizards, you will not benefit from my instruction.
1498-progress.title: Path of Defense

1502-accept.name: Uzzek
1502-accept.text:
It is vital that a $c's weapon is one of quality.  And if there is an orc who can craft quality weapons, then that orc is Thun'grim Firegaze.  He is a hermit who dwells atop the hills east of the Crossroads.

If you seek a weapon, $c, then you should seek Thun'grim.  To find him, first travel to the Crossroads to the west, then strike east into the hills.  His camp is high on a hilltop.
1502-accept.title: Thun'grim Firegaze

1502-complete.name: Thun'grim Firegaze
1502-complete.text:
My eyes have long dried out from staring into the forge's flame,  but some things I can still see.  I can see you want something.

And if you found your way here, then I can guess what you desire.
1502-complete.title: Thun'grim Firegaze

1503-accept.name: Thun'grim Firegaze
1503-accept.text:
I will give you a weapon, $N, but first you must aid me.  The Razormanes to the northwest came into my camp a few nights past.  They would not meet me in combat, but they know my eyes are bad--a few distracted me with snorts while others stole from me!  The cowards!

They took an iron chest, and within it were some forged steel bars.  If you can recover them then I will give you the weapon you seek.

Search for the iron box within the quilboar camps, and return with the forged steel bars.
1503-accept.title: Forged Steel

1505-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
1505-accept.text:
The Horde honors its warriors because their strength is unquestioned.  But the truly great warriors are great students as well.

Seek out Uzzek.  He is a veteran of many battles and now instructs young warriors in the ways of combat.  You will find him south of Far Watch Post, the orc garrison on the border of the Barrens and Durotar to the east.
1505-accept.title: Veteran Uzzek

1505-complete.name: Uzzek
1505-complete.text: Hello, young one.  Here for some instruction, are you?
1505-complete.title: Veteran Uzzek

1818-accept.name: Baltus Fowler
1818-accept.text:
I was told Deathguard Dillinger has a job for someone like you.  If you're willing to show your value to the Dark Lady's forces, then report to Dillinger immediately.

Deathguard Dillinger's post is on the west end of Brill, near the graveyard.
1818-accept.title: Speak with Dillinger

1818-complete.name: Deathguard Dillinger
1818-complete.text: You're here for a mission?  Good.  I have an important one, and one that will test your skill in combat... and your resolve in the defense of the Forsaken.
1818-complete.title: Speak with Dillinger

2161-accept.name: Ukor
2161-accept.text:
Excuse me?  Can you help me?

I have a load of food here.  I walked along the road and braved scorpids and spiders and worse!  I brought the food to the Valley of Trials because I thought they needed it and I like to help out.  But they don't need any food!  Now I have to take it back to Razor Hill and I'm afraid of all the beasts along the way...

Can you take it for me?  I'm just a peon, but you're a hero.  You fear nothing!

Take it to Innkeeper Grosk at the Razor Hill inn.  Thank you!
2161-accept.title: A Peon's Burden

2383-accept.name: Gornek
2383-accept.text:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $N.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the $c trainer Frang. He would have words with you when you're ready. You'll find him outside the Den, taking cover in the shade.
2383-accept.title: Simple Parchment

2383-complete.name: Frang
2383-complete.text:
Ah, that's my parchment.  I heard you'd be coming to the Valley, $N.  I'm glad to see you made it--let's hope you survive the trials ahead. Like I said, as you gain in power, come to me--I will do what I can to train you in the ways of the $c.

Good luck, $N, and return to me whenever you feel ready.
2383-complete.title: Simple Parchment

2383-progress.name: Frang
2383-progress.text: What's that you have there?  A parchment?  You're not a scholar, I hope...
2383-progress.title: Simple Parchment

3221-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
3221-accept.text: While you were out helping our deathstalkers, Apothecary Renferrel sent you a summons.  He did not give me details, but he wanted to speak with you about the wolf hearts you had given him.
3221-accept.title: Speak with Renferrel

3221-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
3221-complete.text: Ah, very good.  There is a matter regarding the wolf hearts you brought to me earlier that demands our attention.
3221-complete.title: Speak with Renferrel

354-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
354-accept.text:
The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades.  I used to work their mills...before the Plague.

When the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend.  We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.

The Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath.  And now they are minions of the Scourge!

Serve the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague.  Serve me by bringing me their remains.
354-accept.title: Deaths in the Family

354-complete.name: Coleman Farthing
354-complete.text:
Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think?  When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them?  I hope so.  I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.

It is a foolish hope, I know.  But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.
354-complete.title: Deaths in the Family

354-progress.name: Coleman Farthing
354-progress.text: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
354-progress.title: Deaths in the Family

355-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
355-accept.text:
You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge.  But the Agamand Mills hold a threat to all the Forsaken, not just to me.

I have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.
355-accept.title: Speak with Sevren

355-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
355-complete.text:
Coleman speaks well of you, $N, telling of your successful forays into the Agamand Mills.

The Forsaken have need of your talents once again...
355-complete.title: Speak with Sevren

356-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-complete.text: Very good. Your efforts do much to keep the Scourge at bay. A commendation will be sent to my superior, Executor Zygand.
356-complete.title: Rear Guard Patrol

356-progress.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-progress.text: Do you have a report of your patrol?
356-progress.title: Rear Guard Patrol

357-accept.name: Bethor Iceshard
357-accept.text:
There is a lich who dwells on the island in Brightwater Lake to the north.  Although he is a free-willed Forsaken, he believes all other $R are Scourge slaves and has his minions attack anyone who approaches him.

But because he is Forsaken, the Queen will want him.  And if he is skilled in Necromancy, then his knowledge would be...quite useful to us.

To discover his identity and his talents, I must see his spellbook.  Steal into his camp and acquire it, then return to me.
357-accept.title: The Lich's Identity

358-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-complete.text:
Expertly done, $N.  The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by our Apothecaries.  It may have secrets we can use against them.

As I said, well done.  But our struggle continues, and the conflict will surely offer you more chances to prove your worth to the Forsaken.
358-complete.title: Graverobbers

358-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-progress.text: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
358-progress.title: Graverobbers

359-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
359-accept.text:
I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east.

I must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal.  Our vigilance on the border to the Plaguelands must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here!

Travel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation.  Speak with Deathguard Linnea.  She has the information I need.
359-accept.title: Forsaken Duties

359-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
359-complete.text:
Magistrate Sevren wants a report?  Very well: the defenders at The Bulwark are holding the majority of the Scourge at bay, but some do slip through on occasion.

We have seen sporadic Scourge activity east of this station, with a concentration around the Balnir Farmstead.
359-complete.title: Forsaken Duties

360-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
360-accept.text:
Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you.  He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.

And if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.
360-accept.title: Return to the Magistrate

360-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
360-complete.text:
It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark.  The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.

But we will not give in.  He will not take us again!
360-complete.title: Return to the Magistrate

361-accept.name: Unknown
361-accept.text: This is a letter written by Thurman, the eldest son of Gregor Agamand.  It is addressed to an Yvette Farthing, though it does not appear to have reached her...
361-accept.title: A Letter Undelivered

361-complete.name: Yvette Farthing
361-complete.text:
Oh...my poor Thurman!  I begged him to leave Agamand Mills with me and my father, but his family loyalty was too strong!  And I knew it!  I just knew it that Brand meant him harm!!  Oh, curse this Plague, and the Scourge!

<Yvette's face then smoothes and grows cold.>

But regrets are for the weak.  As a Forsaken, I have new goals and love is not one of them.  I would thank you for delivering this letter, for I had wondered what happened to my past love.

But that life is over.  Forever.
361-complete.title: A Letter Undelivered

362-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
362-accept.text:
Devlin Agamand was the younger of two sons in the Agamand family, and in life the two could not be more different.  Thurman was tall and gentle while his younger brother was weak and sharp tongued.

When Agamand Mills fell to the Plague, I was not surprised to hear that Devlin was quick to succumb.  His mad chattering can still be heard near the road leading to the Agamand Mills.

I'm collecting the remains of the Agamands, and I want poor Devlin.  Find him, destroy him, and bring me his bones.
362-accept.title: The Haunted Mills

362-complete.name: Coleman Farthing
362-complete.text:
Thank you.  Devlin's bones will rest nicely on my mantle.

If my cold heart can find warmth, it is in knowing that the Agamands are destroyed.  They failed me and my family when the Plague came - now I swear I will smash their remains under my heel!
362-complete.title: The Haunted Mills

365-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
365-progress.text: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents.  Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, $N?
365-progress.title: Fields of Grief

367-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-complete.text: You have done well $N, and I thank you for your efforts.
367-complete.title: A New Plague

367-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-progress.text: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
367-progress.title: A New Plague

368-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-accept.text:
While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly. Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play. Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated.

I will need 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in the vicinity.  You will find the creatures along the coast to the north or to the west.
368-accept.title: A New Plague

368-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-complete.text: The scales are perfect, $N. Exactly what I needed for this concoction.
368-complete.title: A New Plague

368-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-progress.text: $N, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?
368-progress.title: A New Plague

369-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-accept.text:
While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims.  Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.

Bring me some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to complete this experiment.  I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction.  Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern Tirisfal Glades.
369-accept.title: A New Plague

370-accept.name: Executor Zygand
370-accept.text:
The strategic documents from Executor Arren contain all the details we need to wipe the human infestation from the lands.  According to the information, The Scarlet Crusade has assigned Captain Perrine and a brigade to the ruined tower southwest of Brill.

Kill Perrine along with 3 Zealots and 3 Missionaries and report back to me.
370-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

370-complete.name: Executor Zygand
370-complete.text: Captain Perrine's death will undoubtedly please The Dark Lady.  You have performed your duty well, $c.
370-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

371-accept.name: Executor Zygand
371-accept.text:
We are still at war and the Scarlet Crusade grows in strength.  The report Executor Arren sent me indicates Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.

Kill Vachon along with 5 Scarlet Friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!
371-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

371-complete.name: Executor Zygand
371-complete.text: Captain Vachon's death will slow down the Scarlet Crusade's advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit.  But other threats loom.
371-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

371-progress.name: Executor Zygand
371-progress.text: I see you have returned but your task is not complete.  Perhaps you are at ease with the mere humans interfering with The Dark Lady's plan?  Or perhaps you can heed the call of duty and slay Captain Vachon and his band of Scarlet Friars!
371-progress.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

372-accept.name: Executor Zygand
372-accept.text:
Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest.  According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named Captain Melrache is in charge of this evil crew.

I am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission.  Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.
372-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

374-accept.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-accept.text:
Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing Scarlet Crusaders. Tirisfal Glades is crawling with them.

Varimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of Azeroth, the Human race, gets wiped into oblivion. Here in Tirisfal Glades we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: The Scarlet Crusade.

Venture forth and wage an offensive on the Scarlet Crusade, $c. Bring me back 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.
374-accept.title: Proof of Demise

374-complete.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-complete.text: Varimathras would be proud.  You serve your leaders well, $c.
374-complete.title: Proof of Demise

374-progress.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-progress.text: Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, $c?
374-progress.title: Proof of Demise

375-accept.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-accept.text:
It's so cold, now.  The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent.  The Mindless State will be upon me soon.  But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady.  When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.

Now my hands shake from the chill.  If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread I could sew myself a blanket.  Help me, $N, so that I can continue to serve the cause.
375-accept.title: The Chill of Death

375-complete.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-complete.text: I appreciate your efforts, $N.  May Sylvanas recognize your bravery one day. . . .
375-complete.title: The Chill of Death

375-progress.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-progress.text: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, $N?
375-progress.title: The Chill of Death

376-progress.name: Novice Elreth
376-progress.text: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.
376-progress.title: The Damned

381-progress.name: Executor Arren
381-progress.text: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.
381-progress.title: The Scarlet Crusade

3902-progress.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-progress.text: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us?  There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside.  No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
3902-progress.title: Scavenging Deathknell

398-complete.name: Executor Zygand
398-complete.text: Maggot Eye's dastardly acts have finally been avenged.  Maybe your acts of valor will send a clear message to those who wish to bring harm to our people.  On behalf of the town of Brill I thank you, $N.
398-complete.title: WANTED: Maggot Eye

404-complete.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-complete.text: Well done.  I regret not being there to see you smash those $r into rotting pulp!
404-complete.title: A Putrid Task

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

405-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
405-accept.text:
Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge.  You, $N, will be that agent.

Present these orders to Bethor.  He will then instruct you on your mission.  I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich.  And it will be dangerous.

So ready yourself, $C.  You must not fail.

You may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
405-accept.title: The Prodigal Lich

405-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-complete.text:
Ah, you are the agent sent by Magistrate Sevren.  Then yes, your business with me is crucial.

I trust Sevren has mustered someone suitable for my task...but we shall see.
405-complete.title: The Prodigal Lich

405-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-progress.text:
Greetings.  Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
405-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich

407-progress.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-progress.text:
Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your. . .

. . .oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry. . .
407-progress.title: Fields of Grief

408-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-accept.text:
The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge.  Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered.  With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.

This cannot pass, and you must stop it.  Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.

And, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.
408-accept.title: The Family Crypt

421-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-accept.text:
Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.

But that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of Dalaran and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of Silverpine Forest.

I need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess.  Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.  The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.
421-accept.title: Prove Your Worth

425-progress.name: Rane Yorick
425-progress.text: Have you killed Ivar the Foul?  If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.
425-progress.title: Ivar the Foul

426-accept.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-accept.text:
The Scourge are trying to form a base at the Agamand Mills.  If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.

The orders have been given.  The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.

Go to the Mills.  Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.

To get to the Mills, follow the road west.  After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north.  When you see windmills, the battle will begin.
426-accept.title: The Mills Overrun

426-complete.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-complete.text: Your efforts in the war are felt among us, $N.  I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but the Deathguards of Tirisfal will remember your name.
426-complete.title: The Mills Overrun

426-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-progress.text: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, $N.  Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless $r back into the Plaguelands!
426-progress.title: The Mills Overrun

427-complete.name: Executor Zygand
427-complete.text: Most excellent, $c.  Your skill in the art of combat is undeniable.
427-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

427-progress.name: Executor Zygand
427-progress.text: If you wish to prove your worth to The Dark Lady, slay 10 Scarlet Warriors, $c.
427-progress.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

429-accept.name: Rane Yorick
429-accept.text:
My brother Quinn was badly hurt by the ghoul, Ivar the Foul, and I don't know if he will heal properly without alchemical aid.  Although I am not an apothecary, I do know that our apothecaries can make healing potions from the discolored hearts of worgs.

Gather such hearts and take them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to the south.  Then return here with the potion.

You can find plenty of worgs between here and Malden's Orchard to the east.
429-accept.title: Wild Hearts

435-complete.name: Rane Yorick
435-complete.text: Thank you for the aid, $N.  I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine.  With your help, I see that he has not.
435-complete.title: Escorting Erland

437-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-accept.text:
Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields.  We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.

We want Nightlash destroyed.

Go to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides.  If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.

Her essence will turn to dust.  Bring me that dust as proof.
437-accept.title: The Dead Fields

4402-accept.name: Galgar
4402-accept.text:
It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.

<Galgar wipes his brow.>

If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.

I'll tell you what, $N. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures, and a free training manual, too. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
4402-accept.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

4402-complete.name: Galgar
4402-complete.text: Wonderful, $N! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise. Pick one of these training manuals, too. I've got plenty to go around.
4402-complete.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

4402-progress.name: Galgar
4402-progress.text: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?
4402-progress.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

445-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
445-accept.text:
Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas.  Surely you know this by now.

As a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.

Take these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.  Follow the roads to the south from Brill.  From the Undercity go southwest.
445-accept.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

445-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-complete.text:
Ah, how good of Apothecary Johaan to send his research.  With so many new developments here in Silverpine, I nearly forgot about the findings coming out of Lordaeron and Tirisfal Glades.  Which reminds me, I need to get those samples off to the Necropolis soon.

But you must excuse my rambling.  Extend your stay in Silverpine, $N.  We could use an able bodied $c like you around here.
445-complete.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

445-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-progress.text: What business do you have with me, $c?
445-progress.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

447-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
447-accept.text:
Arthas's numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.

My studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout Silverpine Forest. Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity.
447-accept.title: A Recipe For Death

449-accept.name: Rane Yorick
449-accept.text: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible.  It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.
449-accept.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

449-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
449-complete.text:
I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in Silverpine Forest, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.

Your aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, $N.  And you will be commended.
449-complete.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

449-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
449-progress.text: Did you discover the fate of the Deathstalkers?
449-progress.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

4641-accept.name: Kaltunk
4641-accept.text:
Finally, you are of age, $N... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.

Yes...

<Kaltunk looks you over.>

You will do nicely.

No doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.

<Kaltunk laughs.>

Report to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young $c. You will find Gornek in the Den, to the west.
4641-accept.title: Your Place in the World

4641-complete.name: Gornek
4641-complete.text:
Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?

A sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud $c of the Horde.
4641-complete.title: Your Place in the World

477-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
477-accept.text:
As you may know, the town of Ambermill remains a source of human opposition, mainly through the support they receive from the wizards of Dalaran.

I don't know what their plan is, but for them to show interest in a backwater village like Ambermill indicates that it must have some greater importance.

They've been shipping crates by the wagon from Hillsbrad. Many of those supplies end up at a small camp north of Pyrewood Village. Retrieve the contents of a crate and return them to me.
477-accept.title: Border Crossings

5441-accept.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
5441-accept.text:
Cursed peons!  They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps!  I need someone to help keep the peons in line.

You look like the right $r for my task.  Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job.  A good smack will get them right back to work!  Return the blackjack when you're done.

Lousy slacking peons...
5441-accept.title: Lazy Peons

5441-complete.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
5441-complete.text: Good, good.  Maybe they'll think twice before slacking next time!  Thanks for the help!
5441-complete.title: Lazy Peons

5441-progress.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
5441-progress.text:
No good lazy...

 Eh?  Do you have my blackjack?  Did you catch any peons sleeping on the job?!
5441-progress.title: Lazy Peons

5481-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5481-complete.text:
What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.

Very well, you're here now and that's all that matters. Since I'm not going to bother to try to explain things to that abomination how about you collect what I really need... doom weed!
5481-complete.title: Gordo's Task

5481-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5481-progress.text: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
5481-progress.title: Gordo's Task

5482-accept.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-accept.text:
So you can see the predicament that I'm in, $N. That thing is out there collecting the wrong weeds! I'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward.

It is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the Brill graveyard. Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.
5482-accept.title: Doom Weed

5482-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-complete.text:
Ah, my doom weed. Excellent!

<Junior Apothecary Holland rubs his hands together greedily.>

These will come in quite handy. You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today, $N. As promised here is the reward that you deserve.
5482-complete.title: Doom Weed

5482-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-progress.text: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
5482-progress.title: Doom Weed

5722-accept.name: Rahauro
5722-accept.text:
The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.

Return to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.

Again, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of Orgrimmar.
5722-accept.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

5723-accept.name: Rahauro
5723-accept.text:
Beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the tauren people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde.

She asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the Horde from below. Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.
5723-accept.title: Testing an Enemy's Strength

5726-accept.name: Thrall
5726-accept.text:
One thing I will not tolerate are traitors in our midst, $N. But I would be a fool to play my hand so early--it would not sufficiently cut the corruption out of our lands and only cause the infection to grow worse.

But you, a young adventurer, could go places my agents could not... could learn the truth... could find the true head of the beast.

If you are brave enough, then enter Skull Rock to the east of Orgrimmar, find a lieutenant's insignia off one of the Burning Blade there, and return to me.
5726-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5761-accept.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-accept.text:
The primary task set upon me by our great Warchief is to root out the creatures responsible for infesting our lord's great city with demonic influence. The Burning Blade is one threat, but there are others; the Searing Blade for instance, who make their home in Ragefire Chasm, secretly attempting to subvert innocent members of the Horde.

If they are to be stopped, then their leader must be slain--a Felguard named Taragaman the Hungerer.

Kill him, and his heart will appease Thrall, of this I'm sure.
5761-accept.title: Slaying the Beast

5761-progress.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-progress.text: Have you killed the beast? He surely must be the leader of the Searing Blade in Ragefire Chasm.
5761-progress.title: Slaying the Beast

6321-accept.name: Deathguard Podrig
6321-accept.text:
Executor Hadrec asked me to take stock of our equipment at the Sepulcher.  With the Scourge, and worse, lurking in the woods, he doesn't want the Deathguards to lack gear they might need.

I found that we are, in general, well stocked, but we do need more weapons to replace those lost in the field.

Here is a requisition order of what is needed, for the weapon dealer Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.  Take the order to our bat master, Karos Razok, and speak with him about transport to the Undercity.
6321-accept.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6321-complete.name: Karos Razok
6321-complete.text: Ah, an order for supplies.  You will want to take this to the Undercity, no doubt.  And quickly, for the Sepulcher must not be left under stocked.
6321-complete.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6321-progress.name: Karos Razok
6321-progress.text: You appear to be on official business...
6321-progress.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6323-accept.name: Karos Razok
6323-accept.text:
One of my bats can take you to the Undercity, for a small fee.  Speak with me again when you are ready so that we may arrange your transport.

You will find Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.  That is the same quarter where my bat will land.
6323-accept.title: Ride to the Undercity

6361-accept.name: Jahan Hawkwing
6361-accept.text:
I have a bundle of hides from the animals of the Barrens, and must get them to Thunder Bluff.  A colleague there, Ahanu, will use the hides to create leather goods.

Will you take the hides to him for me?

The quickest way to Thunder Bluff is on the back of a wind rider.  Bring the bundle of hides to Devrak, our wind rider master in the Crossroads, and speak to him about transport to Thunder Bluff.
6361-accept.title: A Bundle of Hides

6361-complete.name: Devrak
6361-complete.text: If you must take these hides to Thunder Bluff, then you are speaking to the right orc!
6361-complete.title: A Bundle of Hides

6361-progress.name: Devrak
6361-progress.text: Are you here for a wind rider?  You have something to transport?
6361-progress.title: A Bundle of Hides

6362-accept.name: Devrak
6362-accept.text:
For a small fee, I will give you a wind rider to Thunder Bluff.  There's no faster way to the city!

If that is acceptable, speak to me again when you are ready to go.

If you're taking those hides to Ahanu, then I think he's at Hewa's Armory, at the base of the wind rider tower in Thunder Bluff.  And that's right where you'll land!
6362-accept.title: Ride to Thunder Bluff

6362-complete.name: Ahanu
6362-complete.text:
Ah, a new bundle of hides.  I will get to work on these immediately!

Thank you, sister.  You have done me a great service.  Here are some coins to pay for your time and travel costs.
6362-complete.title: Ride to Thunder Bluff

6362-progress.name: Ahanu
6362-progress.text: There is dust on your shoulders that must be from the Barrens.  You have spoken with my friend Jahan?
6362-progress.title: Ride to Thunder Bluff

6363-accept.name: Ahanu
6363-accept.text:
I have prepared leather goods for Jahan to sell at the Crossroads.  Will you bring them to him?

If you have already been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master, then you can fly one of our Thunder Bluff wind riders back to him.

Take the leather goods to Tal, our wind rider master in Thunder Bluff, and speak with him to arrange transport to the Crossroads.
6363-accept.title: Tal the Wind Rider Master

6363-complete.name: Tal
6363-complete.text: You need to take this to the Crossroads, eh?  That's not a problem.  If you've already been there and spoken to Devrak, then you can take one of my wind riders back to him.
6363-complete.title: Tal the Wind Rider Master

6363-progress.name: Tal
6363-progress.text: Greetings, $c.  What can I do for you?
6363-progress.title: Tal the Wind Rider Master

6364-accept.name: Tal
6364-accept.text:
In order to fly to a town, you must have already been there and spoken with the wind rider master of that town.  You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so for a small fee you can take a wind rider to him from here.

Speak with me again when you are ready.  Once at the Crossroads, you can then deliver the leather goods to Jahan Hawkwing.
6364-accept.title: Return to Jahan

6364-complete.name: Jahan Hawkwing
6364-complete.text:
Ahanu sent me finished products?  Very good.  There are many hunters and adventurers in the Crossroads now and business is lively.  I am sure I'll sell these goods very soon.

Thank you for all your efforts, $N.  I am in your debt.
6364-complete.title: Return to Jahan

6364-progress.name: Jahan Hawkwing
6364-progress.text: $N, you are back from Thunder Bluff?  Did you deliver the hides to Ahanu?
6364-progress.title: Return to Jahan

6394-accept.name: Foreman Thazz'ril
6394-accept.text:
$N, you are a dependable $r.  Can I count on you for another task?

Some time ago I was surveying the cave to the north for minerals, and I left my favorite pick behind.  When I later returned to retrieve it I found the cave was filled with vicious beasts!  Will you go into the cave, the Burning Blade Coven, and get my pick?

I left it in a chamber with waterfalls.  My pick has a spell on it so you can see it in the dark, so you won't have to worry about finding it... just what's guarding it!
6394-accept.title: Thazz'ril's Pick

759-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
759-complete.text: Very good, $N. I can feel the sacrifice of the land in this offering, and my spirit swells with sadness, and pride.
759-complete.title: Wildmane Totem

759-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
759-progress.text: $N.  Do you have the teeth I asked for?
759-progress.title: Wildmane Totem

760-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
760-accept.text:
Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young $N. The Wildmane Totem is made, and your last task lies ahead.

The Wildmane Water Well lies north of Thunder Bluff. Perform the ritual! Heal the land of the goblins' poisons! Let clean water flow once again!
760-accept.title: Wildmane Cleansing

760-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
760-complete.text:
You've done it. You have cleaned the wells, and healed our land. Bloodhoof village is grateful, $N.

May the wind whisper your deeds for a hundred seasons, and may the waters of Mulgore remain clean forever.
760-complete.title: Wildmane Cleansing

764-complete.name: Morin Cloudstalker
764-complete.text: I don't think there could be too much misinterpreting or ignoring of that signal, hm? The Venture Co. will know not to take the $r lightly, or to be so arrogant as to believe we would allow them to steal the natural resources around us without protest.
764-complete.title: The Venture Co.

765-complete.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-complete.text: My anger is somewhat lessened at the news that the villain Fizsprocket is dead. I will go through his personal effects and see if there is any additional information about what the Venture Co. has planned for the future. Thank you for your efforts, $N.
765-complete.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

765-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-progress.text: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
765-progress.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

773-complete.name: Ancestral Spirit
773-complete.text:
You have shown great diligence in your yearning to pass the Rites of the Earthmother, $N.

We, the Ancestral Spirits, represent the mighty $r who gave their lives bravely to found and protect our great city of Thunder Bluff. I hereby pass the duty of that protection over to you.

You have passed the Rite of Wisdom, young $c. Enter Thunder Bluff with pride.
773-complete.title: Rite of Wisdom

775-accept.name: Ancestral Spirit
775-accept.text:
You will now be revered within our great city. Any $r worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.

For your final quest, seek out our noble leader, Cairne Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in Thunder Bluff.
775-accept.title: Journey into Thunder Bluff

775-complete.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
775-complete.text: Hail, young $c. I see you found your way to my doorstep.
775-complete.title: Journey into Thunder Bluff

776-accept.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-accept.text:
You have passed the Rites of the Earthmother and earned your place in Thunder Bluff.

But in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.
